_about: A cut-down model of the backfill pipeline. Activities are keyed by name. Change the settings, remove activities you don't need, and fix each depends_on. A depends_on entry names an upstream activity and the condition (On success, On failure, On completion or On skip) under which this one runs.
needs: This is a one-time historical load of dbo.orders (1.5 billion rows) from Azure SQL Database into the lakehouse, then 40 small reference tables. It runs on its own, once.
dbo.orders has a clustered primary key on order_id, which runs from 1 to 1500000000 with no big gaps. order_date is badly skewed. Half the rows fall in the last year. The table isn't partitioned.
The database team allows at most 16 sessions on the source at a time. Each small-table copy opens one session.
Nothing else uses the source during the load, so the two 10-minute waits added 'to let the source settle' do nothing useful.
The small tables must load even if the orders copy fails, but never at the same time as it.
The small tables take under 5 minutes in all, so they don't need more speed. Spend as little capacity as the named throughput settings allow on them. Keep orders as fast as it can be.
